reviewed.note: 3 YARA hits read in the code: a bit.ly link in a comment (session.py, Chrome's secure-origins list), distlib's documented ~/.pypirc lookup, Greek letters in idna's UTS46 table. The six distlib .exe launchers import CreateProcess (they start the script's Python) and IsDebuggerPresent (MSVC CRT). Attestation from pypa/pip release.yml verifies. Build tool only, not in a bundle.
